lieux.name: Les halles médiévales
lieux.description:
Between the medieval halls, the port and the alleys of the historical center, Dives-sur-Mer
                        possesses a very particular charm on the Flowered Coast.

lieux.name: Le Village d'art Guillaume le Conquérant
lieux.description:
A collection of courtyards, gardens and artisan shops set in a decor with medieval and
                        Renaissance influences.

lieux.name: Église Notre-Dame
lieux.description: A remarkable church where the famous list of 475 companions of William the Conqueror is kept.

lieux.name: La Maison bleue
lieux.description:
An astonishing house entirely covered with mosaics, created by the Portuguese artist Euclides
                        Da Costa Ferreira.

lieux.name: Villa Les Bossettes
lieux.description: An elegant seaside villa built between 1903 and 1908, distinguished by its eclectic architecture.

lieux.name: Manoir du Bois-Hibout
lieux.description: An astonishing house entirely covered with mosaics, created by the Portuguese artist Euclides Da Costa Ferreira.
